name: cf-app-v2
description: Runtime-agnostic HTTP server starter: a pure (Request) => Promise<Response> core with thin Deno, Bun, Node and Cloudflare Workers adapters.

scripts.dev:bun: bun run build:css && (bun run watch:css & bun --watch src/adapters/bun.ts)
scripts.dev:node: npm run build:css && (npm run watch:css & node --watch src/adapters/node.ts)
